messages.subject: Project Cedar — term sheet
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Caroline, Nathan,

Please find enclosed under separate cover the agreed-form term sheet for Project Cedar reflecting our recent calls. As you'll see the headline economics are £1.75m upfront, milestones to £4.25m, and a 6% running royalty. We've drafted the exclusivity, costs, confidentiality and governing-law provisions as binding.

We'd be glad to walk your team through it.

Sarah Whitfield
Partner
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.subject: RE: Project Cedar — term sheet
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Thank you. Broadly we're aligned. Our main commercial point is the royalty: 6% is higher than we modelled and we'd like to bring the running rate to 5%. We can live with the milestone structure and the upfront. We'd also want a slightly longer cure period in the eventual agreement.

If Larkmoor can move on the rate I think we have a deal in principle and can sign the term sheet this week.

Caroline Devereux
Group Commercial Director, Verrell Beauty Group plc

messages.subject: RE: Project Cedar — term sheet
messages.plaintextBody:
Caroline,

Thank you. On the rate, Larkmoor's strong preference is to hold 6% at term-sheet stage and address the detail in the licence; the term sheet is non-binding on economics in any event. I'd suggest we sign on the current basis to start the exclusivity clock, and treat the rate as an open point for the agreement. We can certainly look at the cure period in the drafting.

On that footing are you content to sign?

Sarah
